page_title: CAG 4-3 FRO | Cagliari v Frosinone 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Luca Pairetto has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
90+9' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+9' Referee Luca Pairetto signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Cagliari players have a reason to celebrate!
90+8' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Cagliari players aren’t happy.
90+6' 4 - 3 Goal - 4:3! Alberto Dossena laid the ball off to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90+5' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) for a tough tackle.

90+4' 3 - 3 Goal – 4:3! Benito Nicolas Viola sends a superb cross into the box. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header into the top right corner, leaving Stefano Turati beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.

90+4' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cagliari.
90+2' A goal, which was scored by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone), was disallowed due to offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.

89' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his effort on goal goes well wide of the right post. A really poor shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
87' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
85' A yellow card for a tackle by Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone). Luca Pairetto doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
83' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
80' Here comes a substitution. Marco Brescianini is given a rest as he is replaced by Caleb Okoli (Frosinone).
79' NO PENALTY! Referee Luca Pairetto has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Cagliari players are incensed.
79' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Cagliari using VAR. Let's see what happens.
78' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul after Stefano Turati (Frosinone) hacks down one of his opponents. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Cagliari!!
78' Surely that's handball by one of the Frosinone players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
77' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
76' 2 - 3 GOAL! Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 2:3.
74' Here is a change. Pol Lirola is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Anthony Oyono (Frosinone).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) comes onto the pitch so that Reinier can be given a rest.
72' 1 - 3 What a beauty from just outside the box! Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.
70' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort.
69' The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Substitution. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) has come on for Jakub Jankto.
63' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Zito Luvumbo will be replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is replacing Marco Mancosu.
61' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
59' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' The foul by Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Luca Pairetto.
56' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Marvin Cuni is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaime Baez Stabile trots off the pitch and is replaced by Luca Garritano (Frosinone).
55' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

54' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
54' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but Stefano Turati punches the ball away.

49' 0 - 3 Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes off the post into the bottom left corner and the score changes to 0:3.
47' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
46' The substitution is prepared. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessandro Deiola.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post!
43' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is being substituted because of an injury. Claudio Ranieri sends Gabriele Zappa on the pitch.
42' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

40' CHANCE! Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
37' 0 - 2 Matias Soule (Frosinone) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Simone Scuffet with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
36' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes a short corner kick.
36' Frosinone take a short corner kick.

35' Matias Soule (Frosinone) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the bottom right corner, but is blocked by Simone Scuffet, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to Frosinone.
33' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His attempt sails well wide of the right post!
30' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar!
30' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
29' The Cagliari players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

28' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Cagliari.
28' Surely that's handball by one of the Frosinone players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
27' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Marco Mancosu (Cagliari).
26' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
26' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Reinier plays a simple square pass into the feet of Matias Soule (Frosinone) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

21' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.

18' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

16' Matias Soule (Frosinone) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

15' Wasted effort! Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
14' Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
10' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
9' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
9' Frosinone get a corner.

8' Matias Soule (Frosinone) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Simone Scuffet. The ball is out of play and Frosinone manage to earn a corner.
7' Reinier (Frosinone) and Marvin Cuni try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
6' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
3' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
